criterion.text: at least one mode with no truth input reaches a median depth over the live cable channels of 20 dB on the stationary source at about 193 m and at about 99 m, and 15 dB on the moving source at about 193 m with the tracked position; the mode with no truth input of the highest mean median depth over the six cases becomes the default ref_mode of every processing config

assumptions: single source alone (no echo, no other ships)
AIS reports every interval from t = 0
iterated: no body in these cases, so it is the beam again
